rows.definition: The Inkling-2 loop host reference forward in internal/model: one token per Step with f32 activations, every layer visit (loop passes counted) owning its own KV cache and short-conv history slot. VerifyTree runs a speculative token tree over it and Commit keeps one accepted path.
rows.distinction: The host reference that defines Inkling-2 decode semantics, not the CUDA resident driver (internal/ggufload inkling2Resident) and not the GGUF-bound model (Inkling2LoopModel) that constructs it; NewInkling2LoopHost is only its constructor.

rows.definition: The Inkling-2 loop forward's shape and numeric hyperparameters: hidden width, layer count, loop core range and pass count, heads, conv kernel, sliding window, relative-bias extent, expert routing widths, clip thresholds and the final logit softcap.
rows.distinction: Resolved numeric shape the forward reads, not the parsed HF config envelope (Inkling2LoopConfig) it is derived from and not the weight tensors (Inkling2LoopWeights).

rows.definition: The whole-model weight set of the Inkling-2 loop forward: token embedding and norms, output head, per-layer weights and the loop controllers, plus an optional MatVec batcher.
rows.distinction: Whole-model container; one layer's tensors are Inkling2LoopLayerWeights, and the shapes they must match are Inkling2LoopHParams.

rows.definition: One Inkling-2 layer's tensors: Q/K/V/O, relative-bias and sink projections, gate, conv taps, depth-mix queries, norms, router and routed expert matrices. A looped core layer reuses the same entry on every pass.
rows.distinction: Per-layer and shared across loop passes, not per visit: the per-visit state is the host's cache slot, and the whole-model set is Inkling2LoopWeights.
